---
name: Home or Prime research proposal
about: Help investigate the unresolved goals without unsafe shortcuts
---

## Goal
Home flash or safe idle Prime termination? Read docs/OPEN-PROBLEMS.md first.

## Hypothesis and previous evidence
What mechanism do you believe is responsible? Which parts remain assumptions?

## Proposed validation
Start with read-only observations. Specify firmware, known real playback/navigation conditions, failure criteria and sanitized fixtures. Explain how uncertainty is handled.

## Changes and recovery
What would change, does it persist, and how is recovery demonstrated? Do not propose removing security controls or speculative system-component disabling as a default setup step.
